daily-2026-09-19-d6ff21f1.title: Claude Code auto-mode billing, Codex defaults, and Copilot model retirements
daily-2026-09-19-d6ff21f1.summary: Claude Code shifts auto mode toward a server-side classifier without classifier-overhead charges, with warnings on billed fallback. Codex restores reasoning summaries to off for new local terminal sessions unless explicitly configured. Copilot model retirements scheduled for October 19 and code-review updates round out the briefing; assess applicability before changing workflows.

daily-2026-09-18-notebook-cde95bbf.title: Local agents, Copilot budget approvals, and SWE-bench ranking uncertainty
daily-2026-09-18-notebook-cde95bbf.summary: VS Code Dev Containers and Codex session continuity frame a workflow discussion, not measured performance gains. Copilot budget approval changes the requesting member's budget, not the organization's overall budget, and supplies no free credits. A historical SWE-bench audit cautions against overreading small rank differences; its findings are author-reported and not independently reproduced.

daily-2026-09-17-1711ce11.title: Claude Code MCP startup controls and Copilot budget requests
daily-2026-09-17-1711ce11.summary: Claude Code adds critical-memory warnings and a configurable wait for MCP servers on the first non-interactive turn. The briefing also covers general availability of Copilot budget-increase requests and tracks Codex prereleases, with guidance to check applicability before changing workflows.

daily-2026-09-16-82a47114.title: VS Code 1.138, Claude Code gateway diagnostics, and Copilot property suggestions
daily-2026-09-16-82a47114.summary: VS Code 1.138 is the release headline, alongside Claude Code's opt-in gateway request hints and MCP disconnect notices. Copilot's organization custom-property suggestions are in public preview; assess applicability before changing configuration.

daily-2026-09-15-9f5a149a.title: Copilot cost-quality tiers and Claude Code remote fast mode
daily-2026-09-15-9f5a149a.summary: Copilot auto model selection offers efficiency, balance, and intelligence tiers for weighing cost, quality, and response time. Claude Code adds fast mode to remote sessions where organization policy allows it, alongside reliability updates and Codex prerelease entries.

daily-2026-09-14-ca0e448f.title: Hermes Agent gateway sign-in fixes and a Codex alpha
daily-2026-09-14-ca0e448f.summary: Remote-gateway sign-in fixes lead Hermes Agent's v0.21.3 patch release, alongside a Codex alpha entry. The guidance is to review the release evidence for relevance before changing a workflow.

daily-2026-09-12-eeccde22.title: Claude Code fixes unexpected permission prompts for read-only Git commands
daily-2026-09-12-eeccde22.summary: Claude Code v2.1.270 fixes a regression that made read-only Git commands in Bash unexpectedly request permission after a session had been running for a while. This single-update briefing recommends checking the primary release notes for applicability.

daily-2026-09-11-b18bb3f4.title: Claude Code plugin evaluations, Copilot metrics, and Hermes database fixes
daily-2026-09-11-b18bb3f4.summary: Claude Code adds plugin evaluations and output-style controls, while Copilot expands VS Code Agents usage metrics and code-review auto-resolution. Hermes Agent's patch addresses session-database fragility; the briefing recommends reviewing primary sources before changing workflows.

daily-2026-09-11-aa65a29c.title: Codex Python turn controls, Claude gateway pricing, and MAI-Code retirement
daily-2026-09-11-aa65a29c.summary: Codex Python adds reasoning-effort options and external messages that carry tool-level authority, not user authorization. Claude gateway pricing synchronization requires configured pricing, while GitHub announces MAI-Code-1-Flash's Copilot retirement. Review the primary release notes before adapting integrations.

daily-2026-09-09-68cfca8a.title: Codex experimental worktrees and enterprise Copilot permissions
daily-2026-09-09-68cfca8a.summary: Codex introduces experimental worktrees for isolated sessions, while Copilot Business and Enterprise administrators gain central controls over agent operations. The briefing also covers Claude Code effort caps and JetBrains sandbox policies, with watch guidance rather than an automatic upgrade recommendation.
